reason: The user reported the 3D haze of depth is pinned to the map instead of the camera viewpoint. The haze span is normalised to the nearest and deepest on-screen element, so a close camera collapses it and the view goes near-black. No existing skill covers depth cues on the 3D map; this is the class of work (depth, fog and fade cues in the 3D view), so it is created as an umbrella.
